entries.0dd9c9602b58e8d2: This is a single-segment business that supports business transformation and the building of new businesses for corporate customers aiming for data-driven management, built on core data science expertise. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥3,005 million, and it is handled by 170 employees at the head office (Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo).
entries.3d23258a7e1ba156: A company in which data scientists and engineers support corporate data analysis and AI model building and provide AI products.
entries.7e22628599b17c5f: Big Data and AI Solutions Business
entries.86c16729f28b3c1e: This is a service that provides the company's own AI product "TDSE Series" as well as AI products of other companies, such as Quid, Cognigy, Dify and Databricks. It is positioned as an area that generates stock-type revenue based on continuous use and contracts.
entries.a3bd0870df0bff67: This is a service that provides end-to-end support from identifying data utilization themes through data analysis, AI model construction, AI system implementation and training. It also includes consulting using generative AI and the design, construction and incorporation into operations of AI agents.
